title: Oil & Gas Transportation Safety Plan
description: Free Oil & Gas Transportation Safety Plan template for oil & gas you can edit online and download as PDF. Covers hazards and controls, vehicle and driver requirements, emergency response.
html:

Hazards And Controls

HazardControl
Road traffic collisionJourney management, speed limits, no night driving where banned, in-vehicle monitoring
Loss of containment during loading or transferEarthing and bonding, overfill protection, trained loaders, transfer procedure
Fire and explosion from flammable productNo ignition sources, static control, extinguishers, driver training
Driver fatigueHours of service limits, rest breaks, fatigue management
H2S or toxic product exposureGas monitors, PPE, emergency card

Vehicle And Driver Requirements

☐ Vehicle and tank inspected and certified; pre-trip checklist completed

☐ Driver licence, hazmat/ADR training and medical valid

☐ Placards, labels and transport emergency card (TREM / SDS) carried

☐ Route risk assessed, including bridges, population and water crossings

☐ Communication and tracking operational; check-in schedule agreed

☐ Spill kit and fire extinguisher on board

Emergency Response

IncidentDriver actionContact
Spill or leakStop, isolate ignition, raise alarm, contain if safe
FireRaise alarm, evacuate, use extinguisher only if safe
CollisionSecure scene, call emergency services, report
